items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: me and Walton and Billy Higgins became a rhythm section, and we start playing together different places. Traveling together

ctx.x: We got together uhm, me and him and Billy Higgins, we hooked up and started playing in a little place called The Angry Squire, and the guy loved us there. Man, we could play anytime we feel like it you know, we used to get mad and quit and go back, you know.
